edits.old: The sandbox is DEV only and is never deployed to SIT, UAT or PROD.
edits.new: The sandbox is DEV only and is never deployed to SIT, UAT or PROD. Each service release builds one DEV database `rwb_sandbox`, built in `rwb_sandbox_next` and swapped in (AC5), and the read-only role `rwb_sandbox_read` is granted SELECT only. The content of each seeded document is derived from the seed value, the case ID and the document type, so its hash is stable across rebuilds (AC5). Across the 19 services each schema runs its own Flyway sequence (DP-15); this build applies the baseline of this service and the two view migrations, and the seeding order per schema is schema `public` first, then the baseline in schema `rwb_source_data`, then the two view migrations in schema `recovery`.

edits.new:
Then the sandbox after both holds the data for commit "e4f5a6b"

  Scenario: AC10 Every role has a named test user and the ACE-shaped tables stay DEV only (BR6, BR7)
    Given the seed loads the roles of the permission matrix
    When the sandbox build checks the seed against the test users
    Then every role has a named test user
    Then the deployment gate refuses any target other than DEV
    Then no service table is loaded from the ACE-shaped tables by a batch job

  Scenario: AC11 A consumed reference-data call fails or does not answer
    Given the lists of values are read through the rwb-case reference-data contract on base `/api/recovery/case/v1`
    When that call fails or does not answer
    Then the sandbox build fails naming the call
    Then the previous sandbox stays in use

  Scenario: AC12 A status change the model does not allow is refused
    Given the seed holds a case status change that the case status model does not allow
    When the sandbox build runs
    Then the build fails naming the table and the column
    Then the previous sandbox stays in use
